from typing import Literal, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Recipe(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="The name of the recipe")
    prep_time_minutes: int = Field(description="Preparation time in minutes")
    ingredients: list[str] = Field(description="List of ingredients required")
    difficulty: Literal['easy', 'medium', 'hard'] = Field(
        description="Difficulty level: 'easy', 'medium' or 'hard'"
    )
    vegetarian: Optional[bool] = Field(
        default=None, description="Whether the recipe is vegetarian"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    r = Recipe(name='Pasta', prep_time_minutes=20, ingredients=['pasta', 'sauce'], difficulty='easy')
    print(r.model_dump())
